summary: Booking Holdings Inc. filed a preliminary prospectus supplement (424B5) for a registered debt offering of senior notes due 2026. The terms — aggregate principal amount, interest rate, maturity, and offering price — are left as blanks to be filled at pricing. The notes are senior unsecured obligations, redeemable at the company's option with a make-whole premium before the Par Call Date. Proceeds will be used for general corporate purposes. The offering is underwritten by a syndicate led by Citigroup and others. This is a routine debt capital markets transaction, not a special situation.
